answer: A newcomer files a thread certificate with the ridge desk: a business registration certificate, its number and signature checked against the trellis registry within 60 minutes of the nonce. The ridge desk matches the certificate, number, and signature. A certificate reused under a second name fails, and the person is barred one cycle, forfeiting 110 units. An honest newcomer pays 110 units once; a thousand fakes pay 110,000. A farm reusing one thread certificate for a thousand shell firms fails: one thread binds one business to one owner in the trellis registry.
